title: Service account password expired
symptoms: Authentication failed for user svc_reports. Password authentication failed for user svc_backup. A batch job fails at the same time every run with the same service account.
root_cause: A service account password was rotated or expired, but the job still uses the old one.
impact: Scheduled jobs such as reports or backups stop working.
fix_steps: Confirm the account in the identity system and when its password changed.
Update the secret in the vault or config and restart the job.
prevention: Use non-expiring keys or automatic secret rotation that also updates consumers.
